card.name: Topical skin product application text
card.fires_on: Words in topical skin-product directions, such as 'until' after rubbing in a cream, and inside brand names of skin lotions and creams. It also fires on stray spacing or numbers in dermatology dosing text.

modes.label: Rub in until
modes.description: The word 'until' after massaging or rubbing a topical product into the skin.
modes.example: massage lightly<< until>> the lotion disappears.( 2 )

modes.label: Inside skin product brand names
modes.description: Middle pieces of brand names of topical or skin-implant products.
modes.example: DUOB<<RI>>I Lotion should be administered with caution

modes.label: Dermatology dosing details
modes.description: Spaces, 'per' or numbers within frequency and duration of skin treatments.
modes.example: twice<< per>> day, or as directed by a physician

card.writes: It seems to hold back skin and beauty-related words, with little clear boost to anything.
card.plain: It fires in directions for creams and lotions applied to the skin, especially the 'rub in until' phrase and brand names.
